language.name: English
window.title: LimitPeeker Settings
window.status.alone: Open Settings from the LimitPeeker popup.
window.status.ready: Changes apply at once and are saved.
boxes.intro: Up to four boxes on the taskbar. Pick one to change it.
boxes.name.title: Name
boxes.name.caption: Shown on its tab. Leave it empty to name it after its services
boxes.place.title: Place
boxes.place.caption: Where the box sits on the taskbar, and its order among the boxes there
boxes.style.title: Style
boxes.style.caption: How each service's limits are drawn, or a custom box
boxes.background.title: Background
boxes.background.caption: One box for all services, or a card for each
boxes.color.title: Color
boxes.color.caption: The box's background color. The eyedropper takes a color from anywhere on the screen
boxes.opacity.title: Opacity
boxes.opacity.caption: 0% draws no background
boxes.services.title: Services
boxes.all.title: All boxes
boxes.values.title: Show values as
boxes.values.caption: In the boxes, the popup and notifications: what is used, or what remains
boxes.warn.title: Warning colors
boxes.warn.caption: Values turn orange at 20% left, and red with !! at 5%; PC's meters turn red at 90% used
boxes.logos.title: Service logos
boxes.logos.caption: The logos are their companies' trademarks, so they do not come with LimitPeeker. Put an .svg or .png named gpt, claude, gemini or grok in the icons folder to show it in the boxes and the popup
boxes.logos.failed: Could not open the icons folder: {why}
boxes.drag.title: Drag boxes to move them
boxes.drag.caption: Drag a box along the taskbar; it snaps to the places near it
boxes.services.custom: This box is a custom box: its blocks decide which services and limits show.
boxes.services.caption: Up to {services} services show in this box, in the order listed here, each with up to {limits} limits (PC up to 4). At least one must stay on.
popup.summary.title: Summary
popup.summary.caption: The services whose limits and reset times appear at the top of the tray popup, chosen apart from the taskbar boxes. A service shown only here is still read. At least one must stay on.
custom.editor.title: Box editor
custom.editor.caption: Make your own boxes from rings, bars, pies, text and icons, then pick one as a box's style
custom.files.title: Box files
custom.files.caption: One JSON file for each box. A file you change yourself is read the next time the popup opens
notifications.intro: Windows notifications about the limits of the services LimitPeeker reads. Each is sent once for a limit until it resets. Selecting one opens the popup.
notifications.near.title: Almost used up
notifications.near.caption: When a limit reaches the share chosen, with how long until it resets
notifications.full.title: Used up
notifications.full.caption: When a limit reaches 100%, with when it resets
notifications.back.title: Available again
notifications.back.caption: When a used-up limit resets; it is read just after its reset time
notifications.failing.title: Reading keeps failing
notifications.failing.caption: When a service can't be read for 30 minutes, with what to do, such as signing in
notifications.test.title: Test
notifications.test.caption: If nothing shows, turn on notifications for LimitPeeker in Windows Settings, under System, Notifications
general.language.title: Language
general.language.caption: Of this window and the box editor. The boxes, the popup and notifications stay in English
general.refresh.title: Refresh
general.refresh.caption: Services are read every 5 minutes, Grok every 15 minutes. Refresh now reads them at once; it can be used again after 10 seconds
general.updates.title: Tool updates
general.updates.caption: Turned on, runs each tool's own update command (codex update, claude update, agy update, grok update) every 15 minutes without a window, downloading from that tool's maker. Turned off, keep the tools up to date yourself
general.startup.title: Start with Windows
general.folder.title: Install folder
general.remove.title: Remove LimitPeeker
general.remove.caption: Before deleting its folder, run uninstall.exe in it (or limitpeeker.exe --remove). It also removes the start with Windows and what LimitPeeker keeps in AppData: the settings, custom boxes, the services' logos and the hidden helpers' folders. Deleting the folder alone leaves these behind.
general.startup.caption: Opens LimitPeeker when you sign in to Windows
general.startup.blocked: Turned off in Windows' Startup apps. Turn it on here to start it again
general.task.this: Task Scheduler's task {task} starts LimitPeeker at sign-in.
general.task.other: Task Scheduler's task {task} starts another copy at sign-in: {program}.
general.task.admin: It runs with highest privileges, so the box stays off. Turn that off in the task.
general.task.hidden: It runs whether you are signed in or not, so it runs out of sight. Set it to run only when you are signed in.
general.task.both: Start with Windows above starts it too. One of the two is enough.
general.version.no_release: Couldn't check for updates: no release has been published yet.
general.version.no_answer: Couldn't check for updates: no answer in {seconds} seconds.
editor.window.title: LimitPeeker Box Editor
editor.presets.title: Presets
editor.presets.duplicate.tip: A copy of the picked preset, to change
editor.presets.delete.tip: Delete the picked preset and its file
editor.presets.sample.tip: A sample, which cannot be changed
editor.style.columns.about: Blocks line up in columns from the left, one or two in each; the box is as wide as they are.
editor.style.free.about: Each block goes where you put it, as on a slide, in a box as wide as you make it.
editor.box.name: Preset name
editor.box.title: Box
editor.box.style.tip: Chosen when the preset was made; for another style, create a new preset
editor.box.width.tip: The width inside the box, in DIPs, up to 600; never less than its blocks reach
editor.box.fit.tip: As wide as the blocks reach
editor.box.height.tip: A box on the taskbar is always 40 DIPs high
editor.box.background.tip: The box's background color on the taskbar, as the Boxes page sets it; the stage shows the preset on it
editor.box.use.saved.tip: Show it on the taskbar as last saved
editor.box.width.kept: The width is kept at {width}, where the blocks reach.
editor.toolbar.align_left.tip: Align left: to the leftmost, or with one picked to the box's left
editor.toolbar.align_right.tip: Align right: to the rightmost, or with one picked to the box's right
editor.toolbar.align_top.tip: Align tops: to the highest, or with one picked to the box's top
editor.toolbar.align_bottom.tip: Align bottoms: to the lowest, or with one picked to the box's bottom
editor.toolbar.distribute_across.tip: Even gaps side by side, with three or more picked
editor.toolbar.distribute_down.tip: Even gaps one above another, with three or more picked
editor.toolbar.group.tip: Group (Ctrl+G): picked, moved and aligned as one
editor.toolbar.free_only.tip: Arranging is for a box in the Free style
editor.stage.sizes.tip: The box's and the picked blocks' sizes, as on a drawing
editor.stage.zoom.tip: Zoom: how large the box is drawn. Ctrl+wheel over the stage zooms too
editor.note.none: Pick a preset at the left, or create a new one.
editor.note.sample: A sample cannot be changed. Duplicate it, or create a new preset in its style, to make one you can.
editor.note.free: Drag a block to move it, with Shift straight across or down; drag a white handle to size it, with Shift keeping its shape. Ctrl or Shift and a click add to the pick; drag on empty space to pick several. Blocks stay inside the box; pushed past its right, the box grows. Arrow keys move by 1 DIP, with Shift by 5.
editor.note.columns: Blocks go in columns from the left, one or two in each; the dashed lines part the columns. To place blocks yourself, create a preset in the Free style.
editor.note.unreadable: This box could not be opened: {why}
editor.save.saved: Saved. Use on taskbar to show it there.
editor.preview.stand_in: {service} is not connected, so its blocks show sample values.
editor.blocks.add.columns.tip: Add a block after the one picked
editor.blocks.title: Blocks
editor.blocks.up.free.tip: Bring forward: over the block above it in the list
editor.blocks.up.columns.tip: Move up the list: toward the left
editor.blocks.down.free.tip: Send backward: under the block below it in the list
editor.blocks.down.columns.tip: Move down the list: toward the right
editor.blocks.add.free.tip: Add a block in front of the one picked
editor.blocks.order.free: Top of the list is in front.
editor.blocks.picked.entered: One block of group {group}, alone. Click outside the group to leave it.
editor.blocks.picked.group: Group {group}, {count} blocks. Click one of them again to pick it alone.
editor.blocks.picked.many: {count} blocks picked; below is the one picked last.
editor.block.title: Block
editor.block.none: Pick a block in the list or on the stage to change it here.
editor.block.usual.tip: In DIPs; empty for the usual
editor.block.stacked: Under the block before, in its column
editor.block.place.caption: In DIPs, from the box's origin at 0, 0
editor.block.w.tip: Width; left as shown, the block's own
editor.block.h.tip: Height; left as shown, the block's own
editor.block.own_size.tip: Back to the block's own width and height
editor.shows.label: Limit's name
editor.shows.name: Service's name
editor.create.caption: It starts as the preset picked below; change it from there.
editor.create.name: Name
message.drop_changes: Drop the changes to this preset?
